name: Demo — NotPetya Global Outbreak
description: Demo scenario inspired by the publicly documented 2017 NotPetya destructive outbreak. It adds contextual reconnaissance and supply-chain staging for a rich matrix and is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: EXT-PARTNER
layers.description: External partner and supply-chain layer for researching victim environments and preparing a compromised software distribution path.

layers.name: INT-ENDPOINT
layers.description: Internal endpoint layer where the staged payload executes, host defenses and files are inspected, and credentials and reboot behavior are prepared.

techniques.comment: Payload masquerading is marked seen and retained as analyst context for the endpoint.

layers.name: INT-NETWORK
layers.description: Internal network layer for propagation using SMB exploitation, valid credentials, administrative shares, WMI, and remote services.

layers.name: INT-OPERATIONS
layers.description: Internal business operations layer where evidence clearing, destructive encryption, forced reboots, and availability loss create impact.

techniques.comment: Service stoppage impact has not yet been independently corroborated in this demo.
